items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And the three of us would play, we'd just sit there all day and just play, and exchange ideas.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, yeah, possibly. But when I got to New York the scene had changed, as far as Dizzy is concerned, and Roy. But it was always different. He was a true individual musically, you know, he had his own ideas. And we used to jam all the time. He'd come up to my hotel room and we would just play and exchange ideas, and then we used to go to another hotel called the Grampion. Now, who's living there? Ben Webster. And the three of us would play, we'd just sit there all day and just play, and exchange ideas. And…
